# Event Stories: Party Planner

> Event Stories is a free iOS app for planning events, parties, weddings, and celebrations. Manage guest lists, track budgets, coordinate schedules, organize vendors, and export professional PDF reports.

## Key Information

- App Name: Event Stories: Party Planner
- Developer: Robert Jensen
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 17.0+)
- Price: Free (Premium Lifetime upgrade available)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/dk/app/event-stories-party-planner/id6755695151
- Website: https://event-stories.12f.dk
- Contact: robert@12f.dk

## Features

- Guest List Management: Track RSVPs, contact info, dietary requirements, plus-ones, and seating
- Budget Tracking: Visual expense charts by category, vendor payment tracking, remaining budget overview
- Schedule & Timeline: Detailed event schedules with map integration and vendor coordination
- Vendor Management: Organize vendor contacts, contracts, and communications in one place
- PDF Export: Generate professional reports with guest lists, budgets, vendor contacts, and schedules
- iCloud Sync: Keep events synced across all your Apple devices
- Offline Support: Full functionality without internet access
- Photo Documentation: Capture and organize event photos and memories

## FAQ

- Is Event Stories free to use? Yes, it's free with a Premium Lifetime upgrade available.
- Does the app work offline? Yes, fully functional offline.
- Can I share events with others? Yes, via iCloud sync and PDF export.
- What devices are supported? iPhone with iOS 17.0 or later.
